summary.text: It changes to “Active” only after successful premium deduction, about two months after approval. You can still make claims while waiting.

details.heading: Why it says Waiting for Cover
details.body: Your status will show “Active” only after your premium is successfully deducted. This usually takes about two months from your approved date.

details.heading: You can still make claims
details.body: You remain eligible to make claims while your status says “Waiting for Cover”.

example_phrasings: Why does my CareShield Life status say Waiting for Cover?
My application was approved. Why is my cover not active yet?
When will my CareShield Life coverage become Active?

sources.page_title: I have applied for CareShield Life and my application has been approved. Why is the coverage status reflected as ‘Waiting for Cover’ on My Policy e-Service?

quotes.text: Coverage status will be reflected as 'Active' only after successful premium deduction (about two months from your approved date).
However, please be assured that you will still be eligible for claims while your coverage status is 'Waiting for Cover'.
